blocks.name: Granada355
blocks.source: ENTSO-E final report p.14 (355 MW, 165 MVAr absorbed)

pre_cascade_actions.description: Energize a second circuit in parallel with the 500 kV line of the renewable zone with the largest charging susceptance.
pre_cascade_actions.justification: Report: TSOs coupled (meshed) EHV lines before 12:32, which adds line-charging MVAr and raises voltage.

pre_cascade_actions.description: Energize a second circuit in parallel with the zone 500 kV line with the second-largest charging susceptance.
Reduce the affected area's export by 1000 MW through governor set points (area governor units down pro rata; the voltage-regulated governor units of the directly tied areas up, pro rata to dispatch).
pre_cascade_actions.justification: Report: exports to France were reduced (HVDC set-point change); lower EHV loading reduces I^2X absorption and raises voltage. No HVDC exists in ACTIVSg2000, so the exchange change is modeled as a governor redispatch.

pre_cascade_actions.description: Reduce the 16 protected plants' output by 208 MW in total (pro rata) at constant power factor (P and Q scaled together).
pre_cascade_actions.justification: Report event E2: 208 MW RES operating-point change; at fixed power factor the reactive absorption falls with P.
